name: @local/dsh-six-step-preset
description: 六步思考 agent preset (是什么→为什么→怎么做→任务划分→执行→审计, every step output, audit loops back to step 1 until complete) with an execution-completeness guard; for complex tasks the Lead orchestrates six named teammates in strict serial order, compressing every piece of info passing through the Lead before relaying it (self-contained; no length caps on the teammates' own thinking), with very fine-grained task division and unlimited audit loops (simple tasks unchanged); in the standard flow the Lead stays light — only dispatch, output each teammate's reply as a compressed summary to the owner, then give the final result, never writing the six steps' thinking itself (heavy work is all done by sub-agents); meta-task edits to this preset stay single-agent with no team.
author: sweeete
